name: t38_xss_identity_scene_a
prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the single male person represented by the source identity image. Use this subject only for the person's stable facial identity, head shape, eyes, nose, mouth, ears, skin tone, and short dark hairstyle. Ignore the source image's household background, hat, blanket, animals, props, camera angle, and clothing unless they are independently requested.
<Subject 2> is the empty minimalist studio represented by the scene image. Use this subject only for the fixed background layout, neutral gray wall treatment, soft frontal lighting, and studio spatial appearance.

summary:
[reference generation] Generate a single-person studio video using <Subject 1> as the identity reference and <Subject 2> as the fixed environment reference. The identity and environment have separate responsibilities.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve one consistent male identity, face, head shape, facial features, skin tone, ears, and short dark hairstyle; ignore unrelated source background, props, animals, hat, blanket, and clothing.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the neutral studio background, wall layout, soft frontal lighting, and fixed spatial environment; do not copy the source identity image background.

detailed_description:
The target video is a restrained photorealistic studio portrait designed to test identity retention from one real-person reference. The visual presentation is simple and controlled, with natural skin texture, neutral color, soft frontal light, and an uncluttered gray studio. The camera is locked in a medium head-and-torso composition at eye level. There is one visible person only. No scene change, no cut, no camera movement, and no additional reference subject should compete with the person's identity.
[Shot 1] At the beginning, the single male presenter from <Subject 1> is centered and faces the camera inside <Subject 2>. Preserve his face, head shape, eyes, nose, mouth, ears, skin tone, and short dark hairstyle consistently. Do not copy the source photograph's household environment, hat, blanket, animals, tabletop objects, or photographic background. Dress him in a plain dark neutral collared shirt with no logo or distinctive pattern so clothing does not become an uncontrolled identity cue. Keep the upper torso centered and the crop unchanged for the complete shot.

For the first part of the shot he holds a calm neutral expression and looks directly into the lens. He then makes one small natural nod and briefly shifts his gaze toward screen-left before returning to the lens. His head and shoulders remain in the same position and scale; the action must not cause a zoom, reframing, body-shape change, or wardrobe change. His facial identity remains the only identity variable under test. <Subject 2> remains unchanged behind him: keep the empty neutral-gray studio, soft frontal illumination, and fixed wall geometry. Do not add furniture, windows, screens, text, logos, props, animals, a second person, or a new location. Do not pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, roll, or cut. Keep the presenter visible from the beginning to the end.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet indoor studio room tone with subtle breath and very soft natural clothing movement. No identifiable dialogue, no crowd, no sound effects, and no environmental transition.
